Built against DuckDB 2.0: `v2.0-cyanoptera` at `2ec7e8401c4`, the commit in the duckdb submodule. A loadable extension loads only in the DuckDB build it was compiled for, so on a released DuckDB install it from the community repository instead: `INSTALL mssql FROM community`. DuckDB 1.5.x stays on v0.2.5.

Fixed Sidebar not closing properly 
Download the new hotfix to fix the issue

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rootSTARYYY/SurfMonitor/compare/v4.2.1...v4.2.2.hotfix

- **Vanishing Custom Themes**: Hardened `getThemeState()` in `App.tsx` with a safe fallback merge onto the base dark theme so saved custom themes in SQLite are never silently dropped on startup (v4.2.1)
- **Unlimited Custom Themes**: Added SQLite persistence (`custom_themes` table) for creating, saving, duplicating, renaming, deleting, setting a default, and importing/exporting `.surf-theme.json` themes (v4.1.0)
- **Local Profile Persistence**: Added `user_profile` SQLite storage and `profile:*` IPC handler

- **Machine-Bound Trial Protection**: Cross-platform SHA-256 machine fingerprinting, HMAC-signed local entitlement anchor outside SQLite, monotonic clock-rollback detection, and `SURF_TRIAL_API_URL` backend support.
- **Settings → License & Account**: Added username editing, 7-day trial status/countdown display, and upgraded version metadata to `4.0.0` (preserving existing v3.x licenses and SQLite data).

### Surf Monitor v3.2.0

#### Added
- **Multi-User PM2 Monitoring & Control**: Auto-discovers `root` and user PM2 processes via 1-click agent install/update, with CPU/RAM graphs, redacted `stdout`/`stderr` log viewer, `Start`/`Stop`/`Restart` controls, and crash/restart-spike alerts.
- **SMTP Email Overhaul**: Presets for **Brevo**, **Gmail**, **Outlook**, and **Custom SMTP** with `STARTTLS`/`Implicit TLS`, optional auth, masked passwords, **Test Connection**, **Send Test Email**, and channel editing.

- Android: changing the theme no longer closes the app. The launcher icon now
  switches when you leave the app instead of while it is on screen.
- Site: Cormorant Garamond loads again. The service worker was answering the
  Google Fonts request with the page itself; it now leaves fonts to the
  browser, and Noto Serif is fetched only for Japanese, Chinese and Korean.
- Site: the rule between quote and author never gets thinner than one pixel,
  so it no longer vanishes under long quotes.

### Added

- Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Korean: 1,000 hand-made translations each, every author's name written the way those readers know it, the Day 1 dedication and the whole interface, on the site and in the Android app. Ten languages in all.
- CJK typography: Noto Serif JP, SC and KR behind Cormorant Garamond, upright text instead of a fake italic, strict line breaking, and a share card that breaks lines between words in scripts without spaces.

Android: `one-quote-a-day.apk`
